items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I think of like Byron Stripling. Monster player.

ctx.x: Well the guys in New York, they’re playing a more contemporary style, and I don’t know the why, all I can make are statements or observations that are, you know I can infer things. But and I notice some guys for some reason will be drawn towards a Louis

Armstrong versus somebody more contemporary, versus a Dizzy Gillespie let’s say. Why I don’t know. I think of like Byron Stripling. Monster player. But his itch to scratch wasn’t maybe an ass-kicking bop player. I’m sure he digs listening to it and he plays, whatever. But his natural thing was to gravitate. You know I haven’t thought about it hard enough to say that it’s race related. Just like I picked Krupa, you know when I picked Krupa it’s ‘cause I heard a sound on a record. My eyes were closed and I heard…
